== Hero Usage == 
* Heroes only use this skill on their own minions, when under 50 % health.

== Notes ==
* As with all life stealing, this skill can only [[heal]] you for the amount of health that the target has left. As such, be sure you target a minion with plenty of health if you need the healing effect.
* Can be combined with [[Death Nova]], although [[Putrid Flesh]] may be preferred in that regard.
* The health of minions follows the formula health=level*20+80, so the life stealing is a guaranteed kill on minions with level equal to your level of Death Magic+1, unless the minion's health has been increased by [[Spawning Power]].  
** Assuming a caster both summons the minion and steals health from it, and stays at the same Death Magic rank while doing so, the minion is guaranteed to die if it was a [[jagged horror]] or a [[bone minion]]. Any other minion (except [[Star Servant]] or [[Flesh Golem]]) will die if the caster is at rank 7 or less in Death Magic, and be left with maximum 20 health at higher ranks. [[Flesh Golem]]s will lose around 70% of their health.
*** Can be used with [[Jagged Bones]] as a steady source of jagged horrors.
*** Using [[Aura of the Lich]] will spawn a [[bone horror]] and then increase the Death Magic rank by 1, effectively allowing to kill the summoned bone horror from full health at any Death Magic rank.
